assessment: The pinned snapshot and existing authenticated read approach is a feasible direction. The proposal needs the following reliability details before an implementation or cutover recommendation.

corrections.request: Resolve the conflict between '404/oversize skip and continue' and holding incomplete batches. No cursor advancement or delivered mark may silently lose an unresolved fetch, parse, integrity or size failure. Distinguish an intentional versioned tombstone/deletion established by the pinned tree from an unavailable or denied fetch. State exactly when a batch can commit and how a blocked item is retained.

Recompute the content's expected Git blob identity from decoded returned bytes using the repository object format, and compare with the pinned tree identity. Matching an API-returned SHA field alone is insufficient. Include a case where metadata matches but returned bytes differ.

Specify a wire-response byte cap enforced during the read before JSON/base64 parsing, plus a decoded-file cap. State exact-limit and over-limit handling, including error bodies and misleading or absent Content-Length. Do not consume an unbounded body before applying the file-size check.

Specify per-attempt timeout, finite retry/backoff bounds and total deadline, alongside denied/unavailable outcomes. Diagnostic records must exclude credentials, authentication headers and secret-bearing error bodies.

The proposed state lists blob SHAs but the same-ID conflict rule needs an explicit persisted message-ID-to-content-hash mapping, scoped to the relevant repository/source. Define exact-repeat handling, changed-content conflict retention, and receipt-only suppression across restart.

Define the durable handoff between admission, processing/output and cursor/seen-state commit. A crash after an effect but before the final cursor write can replay it; atomic file replacement alone does not prove idempotence. Describe the idempotent output/claim strategy or its stated limitation, and add that exact interruption case to the offline tests.

request: Return one revised source-only proposal with these dispositions, corresponding expected test outcomes, and the remaining active-work duration range. Keep it limited to these actual reliability needs.
scope: Source proposal/review only. Do not implement or roll out pickup changes, create/configure credentials, change access or visibility, adopt a new project destination, or activate services.
